summary: 120 ft Aermotor LS-40 tower in Leflore County, MS, listed by NHLR in July 2023; current condition not confirmed; no build date, staffing or fire history found.

events.note: Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register July 9, 2023 as US 1737, MS 54; nominated by Jason Johns
Register records a site visit noted as 7/2/23

evidence.supports: Register describes the tower as a 120ft Aermotor LS-40 over the flat Delta land
evidence.quote: This tower stands over the flat lands of the Mississippi Delta. The tower is a 120ft Aermotor LS-40.

evidence.supports: Site is in Leflore County, Mississippi
Build date is listed as unknown
Administered by the Mississippi Forestry Commission
OpenStreetMap labels the point Fire Tower
OpenStreetMap tags the point as an observation tower
Aermotor LS-40 is the name of an Aermotor tower model
evidence.quote: Mount Beacon Aermotor Co. LS-40 Model Fire Tower

evidence.supports: Aermotor towers were made of galvanized steel
evidence.quote: Aermotor towers were made of galvanized steel

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register calls it the Leflore Lookout Tower. OpenStreetMap labels the point Fire Tower with no county name. The coordinates are nearly identical, so the story uses the register name.

sources.title: The Aermotor Company: From Windmills to Forest Lookout Towers

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR entry, the OpenStreetMap point and the Aermotor history were usable. Two WebSearch queries found nothing local about this tower. The register's site visit is noted as 7/2/23 and its description is in the present tense. Neither establishes the current condition, so the story says it is not confirmed. Coordinates were compared directly: the register's N 33.526580, W 090.263410 and the OSM point 33.5265960, -90.2634276 are within a few metres. height_m is converted from 120 ft. No access key set. No staffing, fire, build or fate information found. No photos found.
